versions.changelog:
Initial release of hospital-discharge-planner

- Provides a comprehensive checklist and toolset for safe hospital discharge planning.
- Audits discharge orders with 7 key questions to catch unsafe discharges.
- Decodes hospital paperwork and clarifies Medicare rules around post-acute options.
- Builds a personalized 72-hour care plan for patients going home.
- Generates handoff cards and question lists for caregivers and case managers.
- Includes best practices, pitfalls, and a verification checklist for caregivers and families.
